key_concepts: Observing is a science process skill that uses the senses to describe things
A hand lens helps observe small objects
Leaves can be described by shape, color, and texture
Leaf shapes can be round, heart-shaped, long and thin, or long, narrow, and pointed
Size and weight can be estimated using sight and touch without a weighing scale
Heaviness means something weighs a lot and is not easy to lift
Identical means two things look exactly the same
Objects can be described by color, shape, texture, and hardness
Texture can be smooth, rough, soft, or hard
Some large objects can be light and some small objects can be heavy
Shape can be guessed by touching an object
